name: Refrain ~Mou Ichido, Sayonara o Iou~
original_name: リフレイン ～もう一度、さよならを言おう～
source:
Main character can not understand why Rihoko has distanced from him. When an opportunity presents to be with Hatsune, he jumps at it, but relations stay at more than friends, less than lovers level. One day Rihoko visits protagonist for some minor reason, and feelings awaken anew. There is also a good friend Riko who he likes. Main character wants to be with all three girls... what a clumsy feeling.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角不明白为什么里穗子与他疏远了。当有机会与初音在一起时，他会欣然接受，但关系只停留在朋友以上，低于恋人的水平。有一天，里穗子因为一些小事拜访了主角，感情重新苏醒。还有他喜欢的好朋友Riko。主角想要和三个女孩在一起……真是一种笨拙的感觉。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
